scope: One successful Type 4 NDEF physical readback with independent BLE/ATT proof on the same Pixel; one earlier failed attempt retained in log

fixture.name: NFC-Test
fixture.source: Created in our Pixel application; expected data read from its catalogue

first_attempt.root_cause: Not established; physical RF loss or timer/cancellation are hypotheses, not conclusions

observations: Keeping the GATT connection alive after refresh allowed discovering the Tag Bridge service.
First QUERY timed out; a reconnect while the user kept the band screen awake then received STOPPED and TAG_OK. Sleep causality was not separately proven.
limits: Only a synthetic 23-byte text NDEF was tested.
The band display and Pixel app remained open. Background/sleep operation is unverified.
No physical tag scanning, access-card rights, UID clone or Mir Pay payment was tested.
evidence_type: App UI log and independent in-app NFC/BLE byte comparison; not a raw RF capture
